processor.location_basis: Scenario location (Jinja industrial area, Uganda) -- no real Zurkt processor facts (address, capacity, species, price) exist in this repository or its history. Chosen for catchment richness, not evidence.

distance_method_note: Straight-line only in this pass -- road-network distance/travel time (Track G2's preferred method) is not yet computed here; backend/app/services/roundwood_production.py already has an OSRM-backed road-distance helper (nearest_processors/osrm_route) that a follow-up pass should reuse rather than reimplementing.
